newsitem.title: CHINA: HK gold extends gains to close at day's high.
newsitem.headline: HK gold extends gains to close at day's high.

text.p: Hong Kong gold extended its gains to close at the day's high on Friday on bargain-hunting and shortcovering, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$321.10/60 an ounce, up from New York's US$319.60/320.10 close on Thursday and Hong Kong's previous close at US$319.30/80.

"The market players were shortcovering, believing that gold had seen its lowest point and was recovering," said a dealer at a local investment house. "But sentiment remained bearish amid the central bank gold sales (in Europe and Australia)."
Gold would range-trade between $315 and $322 in the short term, traders said.
Local gold ended HK$15 higher at HK$2,975 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to -5.00 from its previous fix at -6.00.
